overview: The Marathon County Human Resources, Finance & Property Committee held a brief meeting focused on authorizing publication of the proposed 2027 county budget. The committee unanimously approved publication of the budget notice, which includes a proposed tax levy of $66,248,545 and a mill rate of 3.4773, advancing the budget process toward a public hearing on November 2nd and final county board action on November 10th.
committee: Marathon County Human Resources, Finance & Property Committee

agenda.item: Consideration of Amendments to the 2027 Budget and Authorization of Publication

discussions.item: Consideration of Amendments to the 2027 Budget and Authorization of Publication
discussions.body: County Administrator and Finance Director Brian Fensky reported that no proposed amendments to the budget had been received since the previous meeting. Fensky provided a high-level overview of the publication notice, which includes actual 2025 figures, amended and estimated 2026 figures, and the proposed 2027 budget broken down by category; he noted that state special charges were included in the general fund this year as a new addition. Chair Gibbs asked Fensky to clarify a significant increase in 'other financing uses' under expenditures, which Fensky explained represents transfers to other funds, including $5,884,464 in transfers proposed for 2027. The committee then approved publication unanimously, with the public hearing set for November 2nd and final county board action on November 10th.

publicComment: No public comment was offered. Chair Gibbs noted that no one had approached the clerk or himself prior to the meeting.
